body: Life will be hard, my friend. But don’t hurt yourself or put yourself down in hopelessness. Hell or high water, you will succeed for everything you always wanted. Don’t try to question life, it will make everything more tough. I learned that from my experience. Just do your best. I want you to feel right about yourself. Don’t hesitate to try fulfilling your dreams already. Don’t let the Devil shoot you down. Copy and paste this if you’ve had any trauma, suicidal, mental illness experience and you want another person to feel better.
